reply_text:
I couldn't find which dock you use for Marrow Agrisupply pickups, and I've told you so in our DM.

I checked our DM history, #central-team, #central-random, #inc-tansley-carrier-api and the public team files. None of them record a pickup dock for you.

The only lead is Moss's undated Central cheat sheet. Its Marrow Agrisupply note just says "door 4 msg". It doesn't say what that message was, or that door 4 is your pickup dock, so I told you not to count on it.

I didn't use message search, because its results include conversations you can't see. I suggested you ask Hollis or Pree, or tell me the dock so it's in our DM for next time.
